name: CitePulse – AI Visibility Optimizer
author: mikeatcitepulse

sections.description:
CitePulse tracks how AI-powered search engines like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude reference your brand. This plugin connects your WordPress site to CitePulse so you can:

  • Sync your content inventory – Automatically send your published posts and pages to CitePulse for analysis.
  • Receive AI-optimized drafts – CitePulse’s Content Lab delivers optimized content directly into your WordPress editor as safe drafts.
  • Track optimization status – See which pages have pending recommendations and which have been updated.
  • Stay draft-safe – The plugin never publishes content automatically. All changes arrive as drafts for your review.

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Get a connection code from your CitePulse dashboard at citepulse.io.
  3. Paste the code in the plugin settings page to connect.
  4. Your content inventory syncs automatically.
  5. When CitePulse generates optimized content, it appears as a draft in your WordPress editor.

What Is CitePulse?

CitePulse is the first platform purpose-built for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). It monitors your brand’s visibility across AI search engines and provides actionable recommendations to improve how AI models reference your content.

Learn more at citepulse.io.

Third-Party Service

This plugin connects to the CitePulse API (api.citepulse.io) to:

  • Exchange connection codes for site tokens
  • Send heartbeat and health checks
  • Sync your content inventory (post titles, URLs, excerpts, and checksums)
  • Receive optimization jobs (draft content updates)
  • Report job completion status

No data is sent until you explicitly connect the plugin using a connection code from your CitePulse account.

  • CitePulse Terms of Service
  • CitePulse Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the citepulse folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the CitePulse settings page in your admin menu.
  4. Enter the connection code from your CitePulse dashboard.
  5. Click Connect.
sections.faq:
Do I need a CitePulse account?

Yes. You need an active CitePulse account to get a connection code. Sign up at citepulse.io.

Will this plugin publish content automatically?

No. All content from CitePulse is created as WordPress drafts. You must review and publish manually.

What data is sent to CitePulse?

The plugin sends your published post and page titles, URLs, excerpts, modification dates, and content checksums. It does not send full post content, passwords, or user data.

Can I disconnect at any time?

Yes. Use the Disconnect button on the CitePulse settings page. All stored credentials are removed immediately.

Does this affect my site’s performance?

No. The plugin uses WordPress cron for background tasks (heartbeat every 6 hours, inventory sync daily, job polling every 5 minutes). These run asynchronously and do not affect page load times.

1.0.1

  • Fixed WordPress.org review issues for plugin metadata and filesystem checks.
  • Updated the public plugin URL to a live integration page on citepulse.io.
  • Improved filesystem capability detection to use the WordPress uploads directory.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Site connection via one-time code exchange.
  • Automatic content inventory sync.
  • Draft creation from CitePulse optimization jobs.
  • Background heartbeat and job polling via WP-Cron.
  • Admin settings page with connection status.
